summary: Plan and build a privacy-focused chat application named "chayan".

existing_features.title: Create the app shell and branding with the product name "chayan" (lowercase) across the UI, including app title, header, and authentication screen.
Implement authentication using Internet Identity and gate all chat features behind login.
Implement a simple contact discovery flow: allow users to search/browse registered users (excluding themselves) and start a 1:1 conversation with a selected user.

Implement privacy-preserving messaging: encrypt messages on the client before sending; store and return only ciphertext and minimal metadata from the backend; decrypt messages on the client for display.
Add chat UI for a 1:1 conversation: message timeline, composer, send action, and periodic refresh without real-time sockets (use polling via React Query).

Add privacy controls: allow a user to delete ("for me") local keys/conversation access in the browser, and allow deleting messages from the backend by the sender (removes ciphertext and content from future fetches).

Define and apply a coherent visual theme for "chayan" (privacy-first chat): neutral dark theme with high-contrast typography and subtle green accents; apply consistently across all screens and components.
Add generated static brand assets to the frontend and render them in the UI (logo on sign-in and header). Store generated assets under frontend/public/assets/generated.

Ensure the existing chayan web chat application is rebuilt and functions end-to-end for a signed-in user: sign in with Internet Identity, discover contacts, start a 1:1 conversation, send an encrypted message, fetch and display/decrypt messages, and use existing privacy controls (delete message, delete conversation, clear local keys).

Add a frontend 'Edit profile' flow that lets the signed-in user update their display name, and ensure the updated display name is shown in the header dropdown and used across the UI where the current user name is displayed.
Update the frontend login/initialization behavior to load the current user profile from the backend (when available) and only generate/register a default profile when the user has no profile yet.

new_feature_requests.summary: Build a privacy-focused chat app (project name: chayan).

Add backend user profile support: on first login, register the caller as a user with a default display name; allow updating display name; store the user’s public encryption key used for client-side message encryption.
Add backend support for reading and editing the signed-in user's profile so the user can edit their display name after first login.
Make user registration idempotent on the backend so that logging in multiple times does not overwrite an existing profile unintentionally.
